checked_requirements: Prior findings closed: the exhaustion suite is now an editable affected consumer, the full 26-file successor fixture closure is preserved and byte-protected, and inventory classification is separated from prospective custody.

Prior findings closed: CODEOWNERS and the three lifecycle sources are explicitly semantic-only for future transitions, while newly byte-protected tests, helpers, RED evidence, and successor fixtures are enumerated rather than implied.

Prior findings closed: six relevant historical compound tuples and all three successor currentSha256/currentBlob records are censused as historical data without restamping; the five-key blueprint tuple and protectedPathCount 47 remain unchanged and runtime-required.

Prior findings closed: authorShareMultiplier must be inserted first with the specified optional integer bounds; future registry changes require a separately reviewed amendment and version bump, with no in-band exception.

Prior findings closed: base entries come from the selected Git tree; candidate entries use worktree lstat plus stage-zero index mode/type agreement, including explicit handling of untracked, unmerged, symlink, submodule, and closed-tree entries.
Prior findings closed: the root policy is externally source/hash-bound but excluded from its own manifest; required roles and the 20-source roster are fixed by trusted checker code.
Prior findings closed: derivation uses fileURLToPath, guarded replacement, and non-mutating pre-red/post-red/green verification against an independently supplied frozen digest.

Prior findings closed: compiler baseline follows RED authoring and gates RED acceptance/GREEN handoff; decoded-text and file-byte hashes are distinct, and Vite transient bundles receive bounded before/after custody.
Prior findings closed: Ed25519 and blueprint base/head evaluator exports and live callers are explicitly removed, with their preservation and co-edit assertions moved to the sole root evaluator.

Prior findings closed: differentiated whole-file ceilings, nested-operation bounds, preparation commands, process-group stopping, zero retries, and post-authoring cardinality freeze replace the unsupported uniform ceiling.

Deliberate decision 1 accepted: the same 29 whole-file/controlled-variant invocations run in independently prepared current-source checkouts A and B with separate dependencies and outputs; main retains static, custody, and final checkpoint checks without a direct-main runtime claim.

Deliberate decision 2 accepted: eager successor readiness, certification campaigns, and skip branches are removed; historical model/census/Git controls remain, while five predecessor checker replays and historical root-closure executions are superseded by commit/tree/blob/mode/parent authentication and preserved signed execution evidence.

Deliberate decision 3 accepted: a benign forwarding-preload positive remains, extracted v2/root process failures must propagate through the real Bash runner, and the contract makes no blanket compromised Git, Node, or Bash resistance claim.

Deliberate decision 4 accepted: semantic-only configuration uses a closed selection/export/plugin grammar covering duplicate or computed keys, hooks, later mutation, and suppression; valid aliases, formatting, and CI display-name edits remain positive controls; coverage configuration is distinguished from test selection; the ordinary pnpm test step must be executable and failure-enforcing.

The sole prospective root rejects missing, obsolete, partial, malformed, zero, option-like, non-ancestral, and ambiguous bases without candidate fallback, recursive projection, bootstrap acceptance, or accept-either registry behavior.

Both snapshots require hash-bound source/view agreement, fixed path/mode/type custody, the five closed-tree boundaries, ordered base-semantic versus candidate-custody validation, and attributable mutants without a hardcoded registry-digest shortcut.

The unchanged v2 closure and real extracted v2 checker remain mandatory; runner.sh retains explicit base selection, unique real merge-base validation, common v2/v3 base, explicit repository binding, and fail-closed process status.

All eleven workflow consumers remain in the fixed source roster with preservation of job/status identities, setup order, event/base routing, subsystem commands, and author-authorization push-before semantics.

Lifecycle custody retains all eight exclusions including **/.logs/**, requires retained readiness surfaces to execute without skips, and forbids suppression through extra exclusions or inactive ordinary-test steps.
The canonical/hash oracle remains independent of project helpers and preserves absent and present-four literals, encoded-key ordering, framing, and negative identity controls.
No material contradiction was found between the corrected passages, scripts, inventory, source anchors, and the four deliberate execution decisions.

Acceptance is limited to releasing separate RED authoring; implementation, GREEN behavior, runtime readiness, signed-baseline installation, final campaign acceptance, and the requested independent implementation reviews remain separate gates.
limitations: Read-only confirmation only: no proposal script, project test, checker, compiler, build, linter, formatter, browser, network operation, Git mutation, or other model was executed.
Inventory hashes, oracle digests, signed-HEAD custody, emitted commands, and derived counts were inspected but not independently recomputed by executing the candidate.

Concrete checkout paths, dependency capsules, exact authored case and child counts, runtime logs, and observed timings cannot exist yet; the contract correctly keeps them mandatory release conditions after authoring and before execution.
Historical predecessor and root-closure native checkers were deliberately not rerun. This PASS accepts their explicit supersession and preserved signed evidence, not backward execution compatibility.
The eight preserved dirty production owners, remote branch protection, and post-sign checkpoint-to-working-tree evidence remain outside this bounded design confirmation.
